EC1: Participation in another clinical trial at present or within 4 weeks of study entry. There may be exceptions at the discretion of the Investigator.
EC2: Has any progressive form of MS
EC3: Hypersensitivity [AND] to the active substance, or to any of the excipients of Lemtrada®
EC4: Medical, psychiatric, cognitive, or other conditions that, in the Investigator's opinion, compromise the patient's ability to understand the patient information, to give informed consent, to comply with the trial protocol, or to complete the study
EC5: Any disability acquired from trauma or another illness that could interfere with evaluation of disability due to MS
EC6: Major systemic disease or other illness that would, in the opinion of the Investigator, compromise patient safety or interfere with the interpretation of study results, e.g., current peptic ulcer disease or other conditions that may predispose to hemorrhage
EC7: Known bleeding disorder (e.g,. dysfibrinogenemia [OR], factor IX deficiency [OR], hemophilia [OR], Von Willebrand's disease [OR], disseminated intravascular coagulation [OR] (DIC), fibrinogen deficiency [OR], or clotting factor deficiency)
EC8: Significant autoimmune disease including but not limited to immune cytopenias, [OR] rheumatoid arthritis, [OR] systemic lupus erythematosus [OR], other connective tissue disorders [OR], vasculitis [OR], inflammatory bowel disease [OR], severe psoriasis
EC9: History of malignancy, [NOT] except basal skin cell carcinoma
EC10: Major psychiatric disorder that is [NOT] not adequately controlled by treatment
EC11: Epileptic seizures that are [NOT] not adequately controlled by Treatment
EC12: Active infection, e.g., deep-tissue infection, that the Investigator considers sufficiently serious to preclude study participation
EC13: In the Investigator's opinion, is at high risk for infection (e.g., indwelling catheter [OR], dysphagia [OR] with aspiration, decubitus ulcer [OR], history of prior aspiration pneumonia [OR] or recurrent urinary tract infection)
EC16: Past or present hepatitis B infection [AND] (positive hepatitis B serology)
EC17: Active infection with human cytomegaly virus [OR] (HCMV), Epstein-Barr virus [OR] (EBV), varicella-zoster virus (VZV)
EC18: Latent tuberculosis [OR] [NOT] unless effective anti-tuberculosis therapy has been completed, or active tuberculosis.
EC19: Invasive fungal infections in history and at present
EC20: Cervical cytology [NOT] other than PAP I [OR] or PAP II [OR] (Papanicolaou) [OR] or cervical high risk human papillomavirus (HPV) positivity
EC21: Any other illness [OR] or infection (latent [OR] or active) that, in the Investigator's opinion [AND], could be exacerbated by study medication
EC22: Differential blood count < lower limit of normal (LLN) at Screening
EC23: Confirmed platelet count < the LLN of the evaluating laboratory [OR] at Screening or documented at <100,000/µL within the past year on a sample without platelet clumping
EC24: Presence (i.e., above the ULN) of anti-thyroid stimulating hormone receptor antibodies (anti-TSHR) and anti-thyroid peroxidase antibody (anti-TPO)
EC25: Vaccination [AND] less than 6 weeks prior to treatment [AND] with Lemtrada.
EC26: Treatment [OR] with antineoplastic [OR] or immunosuppressive drugs within 8 weeks prior to study inclusion
EC27: Intolerance [OR] of pulsed corticosteroids, especially a history of steroid psychosis
EC28: Inability to undergo MRI [AND] with gadolinium administration
EC29: Of childbearing potential [OR] with a positive serum pregnancy test, pregnant [OR] or lactating
EC30: Female patients of childbearing potential [AND]: Unwilling to agree to use a reliable and acceptable contraceptive method (Pearl index <1) throughout the study period. These methods include: hormone releasing intrauterine device (IUD), hormonal-based contraception, surgical sterilization, abstinence, or double-barrier contraception (condom and occlusive cap [diaphragm or cervical cap combined with spermicide]).
